title: Workspace
text: Edit a title and multiline notes. Ctrl-S saves through the editor override; g s summarizes; g h greets; Ctrl-O opens confirmation.

title: Paths
text: File-only, directory-only, and multiple arbitrary paths. Use the picker on each field.

title: Items
text: Tab switches list/editor. j/k or arrows select; Enter inspects. r reorders by refresh; x removes the selected sample row.

title: Guide
text: Ctrl-J/K switches pages in normal mode. Tab changes fields. : opens the action palette; choose noun:page to search pages or choose a page verb. Normal mode supports Vim motions, operators, registers, macros, undo, and visual selections. Type q then one register character to start recording; q stops recording. Insert mode edits text. Ctrl-R enters the configured review mode; Esc returns to normal. Ctrl-O opens confirmation and Ctrl-N opens a nested details modal; Esc pops one modal. Ctrl-H opens help. g s summarizes, g h greets, and Ctrl-T demonstrates an explicitly targeted input operation. The JSON files configure pages, layers, fields, actions, bindings, appearance, and modal renderers.
